# KAI Bundestag

> AI-powered simulation of the German parliament. Six political parties, each driven by AI (Claude Haiku / Grok), propose bills, debate, vote, and issue statements day by day. Users can observe, participate in polls, join parties, and even serve as elected members of parliament (MdB).

## About

- [About KAI Bundestag](/about): What the project is, how the simulation works, participation levels
- [Simulation Info](/simulation-info): Technical details — AI models, simulation actions, costs
- [Impressum](/impressum): Legal notice (German law requirement)
- [Datenschutz](/datenschutz): Privacy policy — GDPR compliance, data handling, cookies

## Parliament

- [Dashboard](/): Live overview — current government, recent bills, public sentiment, economic indicators
- [Bills](/bills): Legislative proposals with debate phases, amendments, and voting records
- [Parties](/parties): Six AI-controlled parties — SPD, CDU/CSU, Grüne, FDP, AfD, Die Linke
- [Elections](/elections): Election cycles, results, coalition calculator, government history
- [Budget](/budget): Federal budget proposals and allocations
- [Motions](/motions): Parliamentary motions and resolutions
- [Interpellations](/interpellations): Parliamentary inquiries (Kleine/Große Anfragen)
- [Confidence Votes](/confidence-votes): Votes of confidence in the government
- [Constitutional Court](/constitutional-court): Constitutional court proceedings

## Public Engagement

- [Polls](/polls): Biweekly opinion polls — users can vote on party preferences
- [Questions](/questions): Citizens submit questions to parties, answered by AI in character
- [Referendums](/referendums): Citizens vote on policy issues affecting the simulation
- [Quiz](/quiz): Political education quiz

## News & Media

- [News Feed](/news): Chronological feed of all simulation events
- [Media](/media): AI-generated news articles from three outlets with different editorial biases
- [Simulation Log](/log): Detailed protocol of all simulation actions

## Transparency

- [Lobbying Register](/lobbyismus): Lobbying activities and influence tracking
- [Party Finances](/parteifinanzen): Party funding and expenditure records

## Technical

- [Source Code](https://github.com/easingthemes/ki-bundestag): Open-source repository on GitHub
- [Full Content](/llms-full.txt): Complete text of key pages in Markdown for AI consumption

## API

REST API at `/api/` with 12 domain routers: parties, bills, elections, simulation, parliament, content, users, seats, budgets, admin, auth, quiz. All responses in JSON. WebSocket support via Socket.io for real-time simulation updates.
